statement_record.book: A cone over F : J → C with summit c is a natural transformation λ : Δc ⇒ F; its components λ_j : c → Fj are the legs, and the family is a cone iff Ff ∘ λ_j = λ_k for every f : j → k (the numbered triangle (3.1.3)). statement_record.book: In Group, the equalizer of φ : G → H with the trivial homomorphism e : G → H is the kernel of φ, its limit leg being the inclusion ker φ ↪ G. More generally the equalizer of φ, ψ : G ⇉ H is the subgroup {g : φ(g) = ψ(g)}, which for abelian H is ker(φ − ψ). The accompanying prose adds that the leg of any equalizer is always a monomorphism.
